{{Quote|As nearly as I know, all things have gone perfectly with the Avarice. Captain Yonka made his rounds, visited his mistress on Elshandruu Pica&mdash;he's seeing the Moff's wife, though the Moff believes he's bedding the owner of a local resort. The Avarice left orbit on schedule and continued the circuit as it was supposed to.|Flirry Vorru on Riit Jandi and his wife|<ref name="bw" />}}
'''Riit Jandi''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who seized control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elshandruu Pica]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. His [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Aellyn Jandi|Aellyn]], was forty [[Standard year|years]] younger than Riit, conducted a secret affair with [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sair Yonka]].<ref name="bw" />
